technical.summary: Short-term momentum is bullish with overbought RSI(9) and Stoch, but intermediate/long-term structure remains bearish below 200-day MAs; confluence is mixed and risk/reward unfavorable for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: DIS shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 14 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Weak buy signal from junior Democratic representative's May purchases now 64+ days old; current fear sentiment (41/100) presents contrarian opportunity but lacks confirmatory news data and composite congressional signal remains neutral.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (340.96), flat yield curve, rising dollar, FOMC event today, and earnings in 14 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for DIS.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (RSI overbought, Stoch overbought, Ichimoku TK cross-up) and contrarian fear-zone sentiment (41/100) offer tactical bounce potential from support at 96.50.
debate.key_bear_argument: Structural bearishness (price below 200-day MAs, all moving average spreads negative, weak trend), extreme macro headwinds (VIX crisis, FOMC today, flat yield curve, rising dollar), high earnings risk in 14 days, and zero fundamental conviction make this a high-risk, low-conviction entry with unfavorable risk/reward.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum (RSI/Stoch overbought, Ichimoku TK cross) offers tactical bounce potential at support; fear-zone sentiment (41/100) presents contrarian opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme macro headwinds (VIX crisis 340.96, FOMC today, flat yield curve, rising dollar) combined with earnings event in 14 days and structural bearishness (price below all 200-day MAs, negative moving average spreads) create high probability of adverse move post-entry.
